description: GET /v1/applications/{applicationId}/environments exists in the public OpenAPI contract but has no corresponding method in any of the 4 official SDKs (TypeScript, Python, Java, Go) -- confirmed by direct grep across all 4 SDK source trees, not just an extraction-tool miss.
evidence: mcp/build/sources/sdkExtract.ts match run, 2026-09-09: 116/117 public operations matched; ListEnvironments is the sole gap in all 4 languages simultaneously.

description: The WithdrawalStatus enum is missing 2 named values across all 4 SDKs relative to the real set of statuses the backend can return -- discovered during the public-docs closure audit earlier this session.

Webhook deliveries carry no event-type field anywhere in the HTTP request (no header, no body field) -- receivers must call GET /v1/webhook-deliveries/{id} to learn the real EventType. Pre-existing, known before this session; now formally documented.
evidence: website/docs/webhooks.md; WebhookSignatureCalculator.cs / HttpWebhookDeliveryPort.cs verified this session.

description: THRESHOLD and SCHEDULED PayoutPolicy modes are not publicly supported -- only IMMEDIATE and MANUAL. Requests for the other two are rejected with PAYOUT_POLICY_MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED.
Production is not an active environment for real crypto flows today; Sandbox is the current live-integration surface.
evidence: website/docs/getting-started.md; project state confirmed this session.

description: A single Withdrawal cannot aggregate balance across multiple source Accounts -- one Account per Withdrawal request.
ManagedCustody is preserved architecturally in the codebase but is not an available/operating custody mode. SELF_CUSTODY is the only operating mode.
